reviews.title: Good value - quiet enough fan with decent performance
reviews.comment:
These offer great performance at a good value.
They lack the liquid crystal polymer materials of some brand name fans. But overall still offer good airflow at a reasonable sound level.
the colors of these blend more into the case, vs the expensive brown&beige choice.
PWM so you can control speeds, set your fan curve however you prefer (fancontrol, bios, other utility).
Used in a build for a year so far with a 7800x3d (water cooled, AIO), rtx 4080. haven't had issues.

reviews.title: Quiet & efficient for a great price!
reviews.comment:
I installed 4 of these in my Jonsbo N5 NAS case, 2 for the top and 2 for the drives using a 3d printed mount. They move a good amount of air and are only rated for 0.2A. On my motherboard the headers are rated for 1A so theoretically you could power 5 of these off of one header. Although 4 should really be the max. With such a low current draw I wish they had daisy chain connectors on them like the TL-C12 but that’s honestly my only complaint.
They come with screws and silicone mounting plugs for a screw-less install as well. Overall I’m very happy with these for the price. I was looking at Noctua but wanted to try these first, and I’m happy to stick with these. They will be running pretty much 24/7 so I will report back if there’s any longevity concerns.
